metadata.Author: Kitashi
metadata.Statement:
I am an individual who goes by the name Kitashi.

This is the Parent Ordinal for The Kitashi Trump Collection.

I consider this ordinal to be a ‘digital readymade’ - a found image from the internet which I have increased in resolution using AI technologies, as well as my own human artistry, to produce an exceptionally detailed picture of 15,500 by 8,720 pixels. The image is fully on-chain and may be the highest-resolution picture ever inscribed.

The image was first etched as a rune on 27 June 2024, with the ticker OFFICIAL•DONALD•TRUMP.

I have held restraint and not told a single soul the name of this ticker, in the hope that it would be found organically by some lone rune hunter searching names on the network to see what they can find, but in over four months not a single rune has been minted. I think this shows just how early we are in the development of the Ordinals, Runes, and Rare Sats ecosystem.

As a psychologist with a private practice, my clients know me as Vernon Stokoe, while my friends know me simply as Kit.

As an Ordinal Artist, Kitashi is what I am known as, and Kitashi is what I am growing into a Luxury Bitcoin Brand and leading innovator in Blockchain Technologies. The works in this collection evidence how I am a pioneer within the space.

As the sole founder and director of The Ordinal Gallery ltd. and the owner of ordinals.co.uk, I intend for both these platforms to be instrumental in establishing Kitashi as a known enterprise.

However, I am currently a virtually unknown artist, never having had an exhibition. My inscriptions have been entirely self-funded. I have never sold an Ordinal or made any profit from my Runes, but in 2025 I intend for all this to change. I want to see my works go for high valuations at auction and to have large exhibitions at prestigious galleries.

I wish to meet Donald Trump and other key individuals to speak with them about The New Modern Libertarian Movement. I ask that the community help me achieve this and support The Kitashi Economy by purchasing not only my artwork but also $KITS, my BRC-20 Token.

It is a privilege to be part of the early history of this world-transformative technology, and I see my own breakthroughs as having been given by divine inspiration. It is testament to Bitcoin that an innovator can still be an individual with no special tools or skills, just pure determination to do what others say can’t be done.

This is fully in line with the spirit and culture of Bitcoin - a spirit and culture I am producing early iconography for, with my series, such as The Derivative Art Collection, the Parent Ordinal for which is inscription number 70596534.

This series began life with my first ever Ordinal, inscription number 53112741.

The bulk of my work has been inscribed through Ordinals Bot, but the Ordinals Bot team do not know anything about what I have achieved, as my inscriptions have gone through their automated process. I appreciate The Bot and the team behind it. I like that it was The Bot I used to inscribe fully on-chain Audio Video Ordinals (also featured within this collection). These AVOs fundamentally change the nature of Bitcoin as a network. They are the biggest thing to happen to Bitcoin since Ordinal Theory revolutionized inscriptions, and it is an honour to bring them to the community.

metadata.Author: Kitashi (Kit Stokoe)
metadata.Title: Trump Assassination Attempt 1
metadata.Statement: This AVO (Audio Video Ordinal) was first etched as a rune on 15 July 2024. Since that time, no one has made a single mint, suggesting it has remained undiscovered for almost four months. Although I originally named these new digital artefacts 'Audital Vidinals' to emphasise the presence of both audio and video, I tend to refer to them in shorthand simply as 'Vidinals.' Ultimately, time will tell what terminology people adopt as well as where the technology takes us. The beauty of the Vidinal is that it is fully on-chain. No government or company on Earth can take down this Vidinal of the Trump assassination attempt. What it means for the Bitcoin Blockchain to now be a decentralised and immutable video hosting/sharing platform, with marketplaces already capable of making the buying and selling of these Vidinals seamless, is yet to be felt. I don't know if the world is ready, but progress won't wait.

metadata.Yu-Gi-Oh: In 1996, Takahashi launched Yu-Gi-Oh! under the pen name "Kazuki Takahashi" in Weekly Shōnen Jump, where it was serialized until 2004.  The series became a huge success and has sold more than 40 million copies. It has also received several media adaptations, notably an anime television series and a trading card game developed by Konami, which holds the Guinness World Record for the best-selling trading card game in history, with more than 25.1 billion cards sold as of 2011.

metadata.TCG: Type of card game that mixes strategic deck building elements with features of trading cards.

metadata.Role: President of Industrial Illusions and creator of the game of Duel Monsters. He owns many cards that have never been released to the public. He originally wanted to be an artist before becoming obsessed with Egypt and creating Duel Monsters.
metadata.Objective: In the American version of the anime, he wants to take over KaibaCorp and gain possession of the Millennium Items to combine KaibaCorp technology with the items in the hope of reviving his lover, Cecelia.

metadata.CCG: Cards in CCGs are specially designed sets of playing cards. Each card represents an element of the theme and rules of the game, and each can fall in categories such as creatures, enhancements, events, resources, and locations.

metadata.DUEL MONSTERS: Card game played in the Yu-Gi-Oh! manga and anime series.

Rules.1: There are two players in each Duel.
Rules.2: Each player makes a Deck using 40 cards. The Decks are shuffled before a Duel.
Rules.3: There are two kinds of cards; Monster Cards and Spell Cards.
Rules.4: Each player starts with 2000 Life Points. If a player runs out of Life Points they lose.
Rules.5: At the beginning of a Duel, each player draws five cards, which become their hand.

6.The players take turns. Each turn the tu: If a player cannot draw because there are no more cards in their Deck, they lose.

Rules.7: The turn player can Summon cards from their hand in Attack or Defense Mode. Attack Mode is vertical. Defense Mode is horizontal.

The turn player can attack with Attack M.A: If an Attack Mode monster battles another Attack Mode monster, the monster with the lower ATK is destroyed and its controller loses Life Points equal to the difference.
The turn player can attack with Attack M.B: When Attack Mode monsters with equal ATK battle, both are destroyed.
The turn player can attack with Attack M.C: If an Attack Mode monster attacks a Defense Mode monster and its ATK is higher than the defending monster's DEF, the defending monster is destroyed and no Life Points are lost.
The turn player can attack with Attack M.D: If an Attack Mode monster attacks a Defense Mode monster and its ATK is lower than the defending monster's DEF, neither monster is destroyed and the controller of the attacking monster loses Life Points equal to the difference in the ATK and DEF.
The turn player can attack with Attack M.E: If a player does not have a monster to defend from their opponent's monsters attack, the monster's ATK is deducted from the defenseless player's Life Points.

Rules.9: Destroyed cards go to the Graveyard.
Rules.10: The turn player can activate Spell Cards from their hand.
Rules.11: Spell Cards cannot battle, but can be used to affect other cards or the players.
Rules.12: Spell Cards can be played face-down on the field until they are ready to be used.
Rules.13: Spell Cards are sent to the Graveyard after they have been used.
Rules.14: Some monsters have effects which alter gameplay.

metadata.Pharaoh Atem: He is an ancient Egyptian pharaoh who had sealed his own spirit/soul within the mystical Millennium Pendant. His spirit then took on the identity of Yami Yugi, which resided in the body of Yugi Muto, after Yugi solved the Millennium Puzzle. He is the centerpiece of the Yu-Gi-Oh! series next to Yugi and is the driving force behind most of the events that transpired during the series.

metadata.Lore: Exodia was, at first, a beast of such incalculable and intimidating might that he was split up into five distinctive parts, each one of them chained and sealed away by magic from all the other monsters, hence the Forbidden One. That would have prevented his power from ever being used again.
metadata.Card Game: There are five distinct Forbidden One cards, each one symbolizing a part of the complete Exodia. In order for Exodia to regain his tremendous power, all of the five cards must be reunited in the player's hand. This brings the parts of the Forbidden One together, allowing Exodia to break free, his strength being so great that he guarantees the player an automatic win, regardless of the situation.

metadata.Statement: This 'digital readymade' captures the essence of Trump’s victory speech shortly after being re-elected as President of the United States on November 6, 2024. I have selected this part of the speech to enshrine in digital permanence with its iconic line, 'promises made, promises kept.' Now part of the Bitcoin Blockchain, it is endowed with the qualities that make the Network so indispensable in our digital age. This Vidinal (AVO) has also been etched as a Rune with the ticker PROMISES•MADE•PROMISES•KEPT. metadata.Author: Kitashi (Kit Stokoe)
metadata.Title: Nashville Bitcoin 1
metadata.Statement: This Vidinal (AVO) captures a historic moment from the Bitcoin 2024 Conference in Nashville, Tennessee, where Trump publicly endorsed Bitcoin, stating that he will ensure the United States will be 'the crypto capital of the planet and the Bitcoin superpower of the world.' This Vidinal has a corresponding Rune under the ticker NASHVILLE•BITCOIN. There is a kind of humour in taking this speech and putting it through what I call a moneyfication process, turning it into a finite digital asset—in this case, 100,000 runes with a divisibility of 8. I hail from England, the motherland of the home tongue, yet consider myself a British American because of how impactful American culture has been on my life. Much of my artwork is inspired by America and Americana, as well as American artists.

metadata.name: VALIDATOR - CryptoText Art V19
metadata.description: A dynamic visualization exploring Bitcoin's Merkle root through text and network effects. The word 'VALIDATOR' serves as a central anchor, with each letter emitting particles that form an interconnected network - symbolizing the hierarchical validation structure of Bitcoin's Merkle tree. The artwork responds to real-time blockchain data, with the Merkle root directly influencing the color scheme, creating a visual representation of block validation.
metadata.artist: OnChainDoc in collaboration with AI Assistant
metadata.artist_statement: VALIDATOR represents a significant evolution in the CryptoText Art series, being the first piece to directly integrate Bitcoin's Merkle root data. The choice of the word 'VALIDATOR' and its network-based visualization deliberately mirrors the hierarchical, branching structure of Merkle trees used in Bitcoin's block validation process. Each letter serves as a node in this visual network, emitting particles that create interconnected pathways - a metaphor for the way Merkle roots enable efficient verification of block data integrity.

series_context.relationship: Continues series' typography focus with enhanced data connection

metadata.viewing_instructions: The artwork responds to Bitcoin network activity in real-time. Hover over the visualization to view current block information. New blocks trigger pulse animations through the text, while transaction volumes influence text size. The network effect continuously demonstrates the interconnected nature of blockchain validation.
metadata.acknowledgments: Inspired by Bitcoin's Merkle tree implementation and the critical role of block validation in maintaining blockchain integrity.

metadata.name: SYNCHRONIZE - CryptoText Art V20
metadata.description: A dynamic, blockchain-responsive artwork that visually represents the synchronized nature of the Bitcoin network. The piece utilizes the merkle_root endpoint to generate a color scheme that evolves with the blockchain, and the transaction count to drive the synchronization of the letter strokes and particle system.
metadata.artist: OnChainDoc in collaboration with AI Assistant
features: Merkle root-based color scheme that evolves with the blockchain
Synchronized animation of letter strokes that reveal based on transaction count
Particle network that connects the letters and pulses with blockchain activity
Historical block visualizations stacked below the main text
Responsive design that adapts to different screen sizes

data_influences.transaction_count: Synchronization of letter strokes, particle system behavior, and text scaling

interactive_elements.historical_blocks: Stacked visualizations of the 5 most recent blocks

technical_details.color_transitions: Smooth interpolation between merkle root-derived colors

metadata.artist_statement: The SYNCHRONIZE CryptoText Art V20 piece explores the concept of synchronization within the Bitcoin network. By tightly integrating the merkle root and transaction count data, the artwork creates a dynamic visual representation of the coordinated and precise nature of blockchain operations. The layered historical block visualizations and the interconnected particle system serve to highlight the continuous, evolving flow of the network.
metadata.viewing_instructions: The artwork automatically updates with new blocks every minute. The historical block visualizations provide a timeline-like progression of the blockchain's state. Hover over the artwork to reveal additional information about the current block.

metadata.name: KINETIC - CryptoText Art V22
metadata.description: A dynamic visualization exploring the kinetic energy of the Bitcoin network through physics-based node decomposition and orbital particle systems. Each letter features a central node that can split and recombine, surrounded by orbiting particles that respond to blockchain activity. Network metrics influence the motion patterns, creating a living representation of blockchain state.
metadata.artist: OnChainDoc in collaboration with AI Assistant
metadata.inspiration: Inspired by the dynamic nature of Bitcoin network activity and the concept of nodes as fundamental network components. The artwork visualizes network state through physical motion and decomposition, creating a living representation of blockchain activity.
metadata.viewing_instructions: The artwork automatically updates with new blocks. Hover over the visualization to view current block information. Node splitting occurs on new blocks, while continuous orbital motion reflects ongoing network activity.

metadata.Name: Warren Buffett - Filthy Fiat
metadata.Description: 1/1 Recursive Ordinal inscribed for primary sale with Christie's NYC “First Open | Post-War and Contemporary Art” auction December 3-18, 2024. Digital artwork composed of 10 recursive portrait elements to create the Warren Buffett portrait. Collage elements include United States dollar bills that had been buried in the ground for 2 years by Coldie as a SHTF stash. Over the time it was buried, the bills were contaminated by moisture creating mold and resulting in very fragile bills. This unintentional generative art by nature began the Filthy Fiat art series. This is the first 1/1 release for the series. Digital artwork is paired with a physical 1/1 magnetic 3D portrait that features individual pieces of the portrait that can be moved around and customized.

metadata.name: PULSE - CryptoText Art V24
metadata.description: A breakthrough piece in the CryptoText Art series, marking the first use of the CryptoText Bold SVG font and pioneering recursive WebGL shader implementation. The artwork renders the word 'PULSE' with dynamic wave distortions and glow effects driven by real-time blockchain data. Built upon the CryptoText Base Shader System, this piece demonstrates sophisticated text rendering through signed distance fields (SDFs) and fluid animations.
metadata.artist: OnChainDoc in collaboration with AI Assistant
technical_achievements: First implementation of CryptoText Bold SVG font
First use of recursive base shader system
Advanced SDF text rendering in WebGL
metadata.series_context: Part of the CryptoText Art series, V24 represents a significant technical advancement by implementing both the bold font variant and recursive shader system, setting new standards for on-chain typography and visual effects.
metadata.viewing_instructions: The artwork requires an ordinal viewer with recursive content support and WebGL capabilities. Hover over the visualization to view current block information.

If Trump is to become the 'Crypto President' as promised, then it seems fitting to house within the series a variety of works honouring blockchain technology and meme culture.

metadata.name: PULSE - CryptoText Art V24.1
metadata.description: A dynamic, blockchain-responsive visualization that turns Bitcoin block data into pulsing waves and electric patterns. This version marks two significant firsts: the debut of the CryptoTextRNG system for deterministic effects and the introduction of the CryptoText bold font. Circular pulse waves emanate in gentle clockwise motion while a central electric band, uniquely patterned for each block, pulses with network activity.
metadata.artist: OnChainDoc in collaboration with AI Assistant

key_innovations.CryptoTextRNG: First artwork to use the new deterministic random number generator
key_innovations.Bold Font: First implementation of the CryptoText bold font design
key_innovations.WebGL: Direct shader implementation without base system dependency

technical_features: WebGL fragment shader for pulse effects
SVG text rendering with glow filters
metadata.viewing_instructions: The artwork automatically updates with new blocks. Observe how the electric band pattern changes with each block's merkle root and how overall intensity responds to transaction volume.
